standard_prerequisites.name: Stern generating function identity and transcendence
Zero-radius criterion for formal algebraic series

core_obligations: Preserve the exact two dense sequence definitions and circuit-model bounds.
Retain full functional-equation recurrence and 2-adic coefficient grouping proofs.
Group the direct factorial-series contrast and its complete transcendence/coefficient proof; do not count it separately.
difficulty_reason: The authors exploit the Stern functional equation to halve truncation precision with logarithmic work, and group a multiplicative sequence by 2-adic valuation to express its truncation as a short sum of geometric-sum circuits. The factorial series gives the authors direct conditional-hardness contrast.

dedup.scope: Root complete source identity refresh zero. This is the independently advertised transcendental-series construction group; two dense constructions and the direct factorial comparison grouped, no support/parameter splitting.
